title: Quaestor validation report — front matter and structure
description: Validates the YAML front matter of report.md as a JSON object. The x-quaestor-* keys are read by tests/test_golden_spec.py and by the renderer for the structural checks JSON Schema cannot express over Markdown: required headings in order, required renderer blocks, and forbidden patterns.

model.description: Provider model id, 'fake' under FakeLLM, 'illustrative' in the golden report.

illustrative.description: true only in examples/golden_report/; the renderer always writes false.

x-quaestor-heading-rule: Exactly these level-2 headings, in this order, and no other level-2 heading. The level-1 title is '# Validation report — `<package>` v<version>'. Findings are level-3 headings under section 6 of the form '### F-NNN · <class> <name> · severity **<severity>**'.

x-quaestor-forbidden-patterns.why: CLAUDE.md: SR 11-7-shaped, never compliant or certified
appendices are renderer output; a citation there is a drafter leak
x-quaestor-forbidden-patterns.scope: Appendix C and Appendix D only

x-quaestor-refusal-rules: The renderer refuses to write a report whose front matter fails this schema.
The renderer refuses to write a report without '## Appendix A — Claims' or without both grounding_precision_pre and grounding_precision_post.

Under full_agent, a number in sections 1–7 that is outside a renderer block, outside inline code and not covered by a claim with status verified must be wrapped ⟦unverified: <number>⟧; the renderer counts wrappers and the count must equal n_claims minus the post-repair verified count.
